input: Given Delta-nB and Delta-kappa, describe the ∇· and ∇× diagnostics without replacing Delta.

bridge_terms.D0: The surface request is explicitly audit/formalism visibility for the divergence/curl operator family.
bridge_terms.PsiN: The encoded signal asks how field-level diagnostics read the state produced by event-local delta operators.
bridge_terms.expanded_IR: The expanded bridge keeps Delta-nB and Delta-kappa as event-local transitions and treats ∇·/∇× as target-explicit field-level diagnostics over the accumulated relational field state.
bridge_terms.kappa: Kappa is one closure/collapse-state diagnostic target after burden landing and reread; ∇·/∇× are not restricted to kappa.
bridge_terms.Delta-kappa: Delta-kappa remains the dependency-radius delta after a burden lands; it is not replaced by ∇· or ∇×.
bridge_terms.expanded_R: R(H,Delta) consumes Delta-nB and Delta-kappa, then divergence/curl diagnostics can force PARTIAL/RECURSE when dependency pressure expands or circulates.
bridge_terms.anti_symbol_theater: The symbols are permitted only when target-explicit and control-bound: compact markers may print in default governed output, while long exposition remains audit/formalism visibility.
bridge_terms.divergence_curl_operators: ∇· reads expansion/contraction pressure; ∇× reads loop/circulation pressure. Both are diagnostics over the relational field produced by Delta events, not replacement runtime notation and not scalar summaries.

operator_detection.delta_distinction: Delta-nB and Delta-kappa are event-local transition operators; ∇· and ∇× are not replacement notation.
operator_detection.target_scope: The diagnostic target must be explicit. Kappa is valid in ∇·κ / ∇×κ, but the operators are not restricted to kappa: ∇·B, ∇×B, ∇·♥, and ∇×ξ are also valid when owner-defined and control-bound.
operator_detection.scalar_boundary: Scalar collapse is an execution failure because ∇·/∇× do not apply to a one-point master diagnosis; they read a preserved live noetic/burden/dependency/register/route field.
operator_detection.divergence_control: Positive/live ∇·κ or ∇·B means dependency expansion remains live and STOP/COMPLETE is not licensed; negative divergence means contraction toward closure.
operator_detection.curl_control: Nonzero ∇×κ, ∇×B, or ∇×ξ means dependency circulation remains live, so the output must break the loop or mark PARTIAL/RECURSE before closure.
operator_detection.visibility: Default runtime / default governed output may print compact target-explicit ∇·κ / ∇×κ / ∇·B / ∇×B / ∇·♥ / ∇×ξ state markers when control-relevant; long formalism exposition remains audit/formalism-only.

control_effects.reread: R(H,Delta) must read the dependency field after Delta events before closure.
control_effects.partial_behavior: Positive divergence or nonzero curl forces PARTIAL/RECURSE rather than COMPLETE.
control_effects.hold_release: Held burdens remain live when expansion/circulation is detected.
control_effects.burden_selection: Select the loop-breaking or dependency-radius burden before terminal restoration.

visible_symbol_policy.default_output: Print target-explicit ∇·κ / ∇×κ / ∇·B / ∇×B / ∇·♥ / ∇×ξ only as compact state markers when control-relevant; do not print del-dot, del-cross, nabla dot, nabla cross, or long formalism exposition in default output.
visible_symbol_policy.audit_formalism_visibility: May print the full operator family in audit/formalism visibility when algebra/formalism/audit visibility is requested and control effect is named.

ir_projection.collapse_radius: dependency-radius remains live until expansion/contraction and circulation are read after Delta events
ir_projection.what_is_withheld_and_why: Default user-facing render withholds long operator exposition; compact target-explicit ∇·κ / ∇×κ / ∇·B / ∇×B state markers may print when control-relevant.

post_render_gate.cleared_this_pass: operator distinction recorded: Delta remains event-local; divergence/curl remain field-level diagnostics
